verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own RTX 5070 family page points AI builders to curated, GPU-optimized SDKs, and NVIDIA's first-party CUDA Toolkit provides libraries, a C/C++ compiler, a runtime, and Python/C++ tile programming SDKs to build against. The NVIDIA developer portal also serves an llms.txt for AI-native tooling. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA-docs statement of RTX 5070 Ti/Blackwell consumer support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with these SDKs on this card.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
